DESIGNATION 5.1 The mushroom ventilator with adjustable head - cast iron type shall be designated by the name, type, the nominal size and number of this standard. Example: A mushroom ventilator with adjustable head -cast iron type of nominal size 150 mm, conforming to this standard shall be designated as: Mushroom Ventilator with Adjustable Head - Cast Iron Type 150 IS : 3282. to the
